title.zh: 用 ggplot2 绘制基因组与序列关系
title.en: Plot genomes and sequence relationships with ggplot2

description.zh: 比较多条序列、绘制环形注释、查看局部比对，或把多张图连接成一个综合视图。
description.en: Compare sequences, annotate circular maps, inspect local alignments or connect multiple plots in one view.

description.zh: 按想画的图或要调整的图层查找。
description.en: Find a plot type or learn how to adjust a layer.

description.zh: 查找文件读取、坐标转换与输出检查。
description.en: Read files, transform coordinates and check output.

description.zh: 查找函数用法、参数与返回值。
description.en: Look up function usage, arguments and return values.

purpose.zh: 比较基因组或基因簇，查看注释位置与区间之间的连接。
purpose.en: Compare genomes or gene clusters through annotations and interval relationships.

purpose.zh: 沿一条环形序列组织特征、名称与定量轨道。
purpose.en: Organize features, labels and quantitative tracks around one circular sequence.

purpose.zh: 在两条坐标轴上查看序列比对区段、方向与一致性。
purpose.en: Inspect aligned intervals, direction and identity on two sequence axes.

purpose.zh: 组合弦图、共线性图、径向视图和局部细节，用真实区间连接独立面板。
purpose.en: Combine Chord, Collinear, radial and detailed views, connecting independent panels through real intervals.
